arguments.command:
sudo tee /etc/init.d/legacy_monitor >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          legacy_monitor
# Required-Start:    $remote_fs $syslog
# Required-Stop:     $remote_fs $syslog
# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5
# Default-Stop:      0 1 6
# Short-Description: Legacy monitor daemon
# Description:       Starts/stops the legacy monitor script.
### END INIT INFO

PATH=/sbin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/usr/bin
NAME=legacy_monitor
DESC="Legacy monitor"
DAEMON=/usr/local/bin/legacy_monitor.sh
PIDFILE=/var/run/$NAME.pid
LOGFILE=/var/log/$NAME.log

. /lib/lsb/init-functions

start_daemon() {
    if [ ! -x "$DAEMON" ]; then
        log_failure_msg "$DAEMON not found or not executable"
        return 5
    fi

    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then
        log_success_msg "$DESC already running"
        return 0
    fi

    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PIDFILE")" || true

    # Start in background and record PID
    nohup "$DAEMON" >>"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
    echo $! >"$PIDFILE"

    if kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then
        log_success_msg "Started $DESC"
        return 0
    else
        log_failure_msg "Failed to start $DESC"
        rm -f "$PIDFILE"
        return 1
    fi
}

stop_daemon() {
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
        PID="$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)"
        if [ -n "$PID" ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
            kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
            # Wait up to 10s
            i=0
            while kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null && [ $i -lt 10 ]; do
                sleep 1
                i=$((i+1))
            done
            if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
                kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
        fi
        rm -f "$PIDFILE"
        log_success_msg "Stopped $DESC"
        return 0
    else
        # Fallback: try pkill by script name
        pkill -f "$DAEMON" 2>/dev/null || true
        log_success_msg "Stopped $DESC (no pidfile)"
        return 0
    fi
}

status_daemon() {
    if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null; then
        log_success_msg "$DESC is running"
        return 0
    else
        log_failure_msg "$DESC is not running"
        return 3
    fi
}

case "$1" in
    start)
        start_daemon
        exit $?
        ;;
    stop)
        stop_daemon
        exit $?
        ;;
    restart|force-reload)
        stop_daemon
        start_daemon
        exit $?
        ;;
    status)
        status_daemon
        exit $?
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: /etc/init.d/$NAME {start|stop|restart|force-reload|status}"
        exit 2
        ;;
esac
EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /etc/init.d/legacy_monitor
sudo chown root:root /etc/init.d/legacy_monitor
